feature: Modal phone slide-in sweep, PR B1: the hand-rolled deck sheets take the phone entry, and the New folder dialog becomes a bottom sheet on a phone
note: Signed in on local-dev or a scratch branch. Writes nothing (the New folder dialog is dismissed unsent). A photo taken at rest cannot show the slide; `pnpm probe:modal-sweep` presses the sheets at 390 and 1300 and reads the animation name the frame each mounts. The Export, copy chooser and got-it sheets need an owned deck, an owned copy or a cart, so they are probed (Export) or covered by the markup and the PR D guard.
